Core Specialized Service

Customs Clearance

We handle the legal entry and exit of your goods at all 50 customs offices in Mexico, making sure you pay only what is due and your cargo keeps moving.

What we do for you

  • What it includes: Customs entry (pedimento) preparation and validation, duty and tax calculation (IGI, VAT, DTA), document review, pre-inspection of goods and release.

    Who it is for: Companies that buy from foreign suppliers.

Added value at Serviproce

  • Real-time tracking of the entry (pedimento) status
  • Electronic file for every operation
  • Fast response to customs inspections (red light)

How do we work?

  1. 01

    Quote

    We review your operation, identify procedures and regulations up front and an advisor follows up with you directly.

  2. 02

    Documentation (Optional / Flexible)

    If you have documents ready, we review them; if not, our advisory team guides you step-by-step to handle them easily.

  3. 03

    Shipment

    We coordinate air, ocean or land transport with the corresponding agent or broker.

  4. 04

    Clearance

    We file the entry, track its status and handle any customs inspection.

  5. 05

    Delivery

    Once released, the goods are delivered to their destination and you receive the electronic file of the operation.
